_readme: Measured factors for rlsim. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Values here are the simulator defaults; replace them with measurements (see experiment-plan.md). Load with load_factors(cluster, 'factors.json').

H200-141G._from: E1 concurrency sweep (fit_inference) and E4 training throughput (calibrate)

cluster._from: E2 (mem_usable), E4 (train_scale_eff), E5 (switch_*, load_gbs), E6 (sync_fixed_s, intra_gbs, net_gbs), E7 (tp_eff)
